mesh.doc: Mesh used for rendering. Created on load() - will be null on the server!

cloudMesh.doc: Mesh used for rendering planet clouds. Null if no clouds are present.

gridMesh.doc: Mesh used for rendering planet grid outlines. Null on server or if {@link #grid} is null.

position.doc: Position in global coordinates. Will be 0,0,0 until the Universe updates it.

grid.doc: Grid used for the sectors on the planet. Null if this planet can't be landed on.

generator.doc: Generator that will make the planet. Can be null for planets that don't need to be landed on.

sectors.doc: Array of sectors; directly maps to tiles in the grid.

orbitSpacing.doc: Default spacing between planet orbits in world units. This is defined per-parent!

radius.doc: Radius of this planet's sphere. Does not take into account satellites.

drawOrbit.doc: Whether to draw the orbital circle.

orbitRadius.doc: Orbital radius around the sun. Do not change unless you know exactly what you are doing.

totalRadius.doc: Total radius of this planet and all its children.

orbitTime.doc: Time for the planet to orbit around the sun once, in seconds. One year.

rotateTime.doc: Time for the planet to perform a full revolution, in seconds. One day.

orbitOffset.doc: Random orbit angle offset to prevent planets from starting out in a line.

tidalLock.doc: Whether this planet is tidally locked relative to its parent - see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tidal_locking

accessible.doc: Whether this planet is listed in the planet access UI. *

defaultEnv.doc: Environment flags for sectors on this planet.

updateLighting.doc: If true, a day/night cycle is simulated.

startSector.doc: The default starting sector displayed to the map dialog.

sectorSeed.doc: Seed for sector base generation on this planet. -1 to use a random one based on ID.

launchCapacityMultiplier.doc: multiplier for core item capacity when launching

bloom.doc: Whether the bloom render effect is enabled.

landCloudColor.doc: Tint of clouds displayed when landing.

lightColor.doc: For suns, this is the color that shines on other planets. Does nothing for children.

iconColor.doc: Icon for appearance in planet list.

hasAtmosphere.doc: Whether this planet has an atmosphere.

allowLaunchSchematics.doc: Whether to allow users to specify a custom launch schematic for this map.

allowLaunchLoadout.doc: Whether to allow users to specify the resources they take to this map.

allowSectorInvasion.doc: Whether to simulate sector invasions from enemy bases.

allowLegacyLaunchPads.doc: If true, legacy launch pads can be enabled.

clearSectorOnLose.doc: If true, sectors saves are cleared when lost.

enemyBuildSpeedMultiplier.doc: Multiplier for enemy rebuild speeds; only applied in campaign (not standard rules)

enemyFactoryActivationDelay.doc: Default activation delay for enemy factories, if not set in the campaign.

enemyInfiniteItems.doc: If true, the enemy team always has infinite items.

enemyCoreSpawnReplace.doc: If true, enemy cores are replaced with spawnpoints on this planet (for invasions)

prebuildBase.doc: If true, blocks in the radius of the core will be removed and "built up" in a shockwave upon landing.

allowWaves.doc: If true, waves are created on sector loss. TODO remove.

allowLaunchToNumbered.doc: If false, players are unable to land on this planet's numbered sectors.

allowCampaignRules.doc: If true, the player is allowed to change the difficulty/rules in the planet UI.

icon.doc: Icon as displayed in the planet selection dialog. This is a string, as drawables are null at load time.

launchMusic.doc: Plays in the planet dialog when this planet is selected.

ambientMusic.doc: Overrides random ambient music to be played.

darkMusic.doc: Overrides music that is played in certain situations, like during boss waves or low core health.

alwaysPlayMusic.doc: If true, this overrides the game setting to always play ambient music.

parent.doc: Parent body that this planet orbits around. If null, this planet is considered to be in the middle of the solar system.

solarSystem.doc: The root parent of the whole solar system this planet is in.

children.doc: All planets orbiting this one, in ascending order of radius.

techTree.doc: Default root node shown when the tech tree is opened here.

launchCandidates.doc: Planets that can be launched to from this one.

allowSelfSectorLaunch.doc: Whether interplanetary accelerators can launch to 'any' procedural sector on this planet's surface.

autoAssignPlanet.doc: If true, all content in this planet's tech tree will be assigned this planet in their shownPlanets.

unlockedOnLand.doc: Content (usually planet-specific) that is unlocked upon landing here.

meshLoader.doc: Loads the mesh. Clientside only. Defaults to a boring sphere mesh.

cloudMeshLoader.doc: Loads the mesh. Clientside only. Defaults to a boring sphere mesh.

gridMeshLoader.doc: Loads the planet grid outline mesh. Clientside only.

statParent.doc: If set, this planet will have the same stats as its parent. Use for shared campaigns.

updateGroup.doc: Planets that are allowed to update at the same time as this one for background calculations.

campaignRules.doc: Global difficulty/modifier settings for this planet's campaign.

ruleSetter.doc: Sets up rules on game load for any sector on this planet. In JSON mods, this field is called "rules", and expects an object.

sectorCaptureReplacements.doc: Replaces specific blocks on the map upon sector capture. Used for metal floor tiles on Serpulo. Unstable API, may be removed!

showRtsAIRule.doc: If true, RTS AI can be customized.

loadPlanetData.doc: If true, planet data is loaded as 'planets/{name}.json'. This is only tested/functional in vanilla!

data.doc: Data indicating attack sector positions and sector mappings.
